events.event: The IHSG closed down 3.78% on 3 November, falling back below 5,000 on the day of the US midterm elections and a KSSK press conference, one day after the HSC-stock exclusion took effect.
events.key_numbers: Close 4,904.29 (-192.54 pts, -3.78%) · open about 5,126 · below 5,000 before 11:00 WIB · volume 226.69 million lots · value Rp10.22T · Brent -7.63% to US$104.77 on 2 Nov
events.why_it_matters: The index investors watch is back under 5,000 just after the new index rules started, and no single cause is confirmed.
events.spreading_evidence: Two CNBC 'Breaking' IHSG pieces on 3 Nov; top of CNBC market page

events.event: Foreign investors net sold Rp831.55 billion in the first session on 3 November, led by BBRI, TLKM and ANTM.
events.key_numbers: Net foreign sell Rp831.55B · foreign buy Rp1.61T · foreign sell Rp2.44T · IHSG 4,963.06 (-2.62%) at session I close · BBRI Rp173.45B · TLKM Rp95.77B · ANTM Rp69.40B · BUMI Rp59.93B · TPIA Rp54.46B
events.why_it_matters: Foreign selling of big banks and blue chips hits the shares in many retail portfolios and pension funds.

events.event: The rupiah weakened to Rp18,145 per US dollar, and BI Governor Destry Damayanti blamed external factors, mainly Middle East escalation.
events.key_numbers: Rp18,145/US$ (CNBC, as of 2 Nov) · about Rp17,830 at end of Q3 · record-low status not confirmed in the article
events.why_it_matters: A weaker rupiah raises prices of imported goods, fuel and overseas tuition.

events.event: OJK chair Friderica Widyasari Dewi said the capital market reform is like a 'detox' and a red IHSG is a consequence, calling it the largest reform in Indonesia's capital market history.
events.key_numbers: Capital raising through Oct 2026 Rp205.77T · 7 IPOs · 20 limited public offerings (PUT) · 11 debt issuances · no reform deadlines given
events.why_it_matters: The regulator is telling investors to expect pain from the clean-up, which may reassure or alarm.
events.spreading_evidence: CNBC market page; KSSK press conference 3 Nov

events.event: Finance Minister Suahasil Nazara said the Finance Ministry will not become a shareholder in the Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) demutualization and remains only a policymaker.
events.key_numbers: No stake sizes or shareholder names given · BEI cash dividend Rp1.56T before demutualization appears only in a related headline (unconfirmed)
events.why_it_matters: Who will own the exchange matters for MSCI's view of governance.

events.event: Social media posts claimed customers of PT Bank MNC Internasional (BABP) could not withdraw funds; OJK said supervision found no serious issues and urged calm.
events.key_numbers: Claimed Rp500,000 withdrawal cap at a Bonjer branch on 2 Nov (unverified social post) · MNC Bank Q3 headline: profit -22%, deposits -17% (headline only)
events.why_it_matters: Bank-run rumours test whether people trust their deposits (LPS guarantee is a natural explainer).
events.spreading_evidence: Two CNBC articles plus OJK statements; viral on Threads

events.event: The Finance Ministry reported Q3 2026 state revenue of Rp2,341.5T, up 25.5% year on year, helped by Coretax, with spending at Rp2,660.5T.
events.key_numbers: Revenue Rp2,341.5T (+25.5%) · tax Rp1,847.7T (+21.8%) · customs/excise Rp240.1T (+8.5%) · PNBP Rp492.3T (+41.7%) · spending Rp2,660.5T (+19%) · financing Rp462T · components do not sum to total in the article
events.why_it_matters: Shows how much more tax the state is collecting and how much it is spending.

events.event: Finance Minister said foreign investors net bought Rp28.79T of government bonds (SBN) at the KSSK press conference, as the government says the financial system stayed stable.
events.key_numbers: Net foreign SBN buying Rp28.79T · 10-year SUN vs US Treasury spread 183 bps · period not stated exactly
events.why_it_matters: Foreigners are selling stocks but buying bonds, a mixed signal for the rupiah.
